description: Starts a one-off payment for the full report and ready-to-send replies. The price depends on the amount the points challenge (US$19 / US$39 / US$59 / US$89 in United States; A$29 / A$59 / A$89 / A$129 in Australia; £15 / £29 / £45 / £69 in United Kingdom; €17 / €35 / €55 / €79 in Ireland; C$25 / C$55 / C$79 / C$119 in Canada; NZ$29 / NZ$59 / NZ$95 / NZ$149 in New Zealand for under 300, 300 to 1,000, 1,000 to 2,500 and over 2,500 challenged; tax included, one-off, no subscription) and is shown on the report before paying. Returns a secure Stripe checkout link that the user opens and pays on themselves (Apple Pay, Google Pay or card). neatly never needs card details in the conversation. Once paid, the full report is available from the same report. Only offer it when the user wants the full report.
